edition.window: Orders and decisions reported on 23–24 September 2026

items.headline: IBC order affecting possession is not a landlord-tenant matter
items.text: NCLAT upheld the eviction of occupants from Venus Garments' properties through IBC proceedings, holding that the effect of an IBC order on possession does not turn the dispute into a landlord-tenant matter.

items.headline: Fraudulent intent not needed to prove a preferential transaction
items.text: The effect of a transaction, not the intent behind it, decides whether it is a preferential transaction under the IBC.

items.headline: Insolvency plea against Shapoorji Pallonji dismissed
items.text: The Mumbai bench declined to admit the insolvency petition against Shapoorji Pallonji.

items.headline: Secured creditors must bear liquidation costs
items.text: Secured creditors who realise their security cannot avoid their share of liquidation costs by pointing to expenses that are not yet finalised.

items.headline: Differential duty can be demanded without challenging self-assessment
items.text: Customs may issue a demand under Section 28 of the Customs Act for differential duty without first challenging the importer's self-assessment.

items.headline: Reassessment quashed over a defective notice
items.text: A defect in the reassessment notice vitiated the proceedings against the company.

items.caseName: Combination: L'Oréal India Pvt. Ltd. / Onesto Labs Pvt. Ltd.
items.headline: CCI approves L'Oréal India's 100% acquisition of Onesto Labs
items.text: The Commission cleared the combination under the Competition Act, 2002.
